author: nickyeow

english.text: He won the public speaking contest.
She won the public speaking contest.

jyutping: keoi5 hai2 go3 jin2 gong2 bei2 coi3 dou6 lo2 zo2 gun3 gwan1。
text: 佢喺個演講比賽度攞咗冠軍。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The door opened and a man came out.

jyutping: jau5 go3 naam4 jan2 hoi1 mun4 zau2 zo2 ceot1 lai4。
text: 有個男人開門走咗出嚟。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you know how to use this camera?

jyutping: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 jung6 ne1 bou6 soeng2 gei1 aa3？
text: 你識唔識用呢部相機呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: The doctor is not available now.

jyutping: ji1 sang1 ji4 gaa1 m4 dak1 haan4。
text: 醫生而家唔得閒。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We all chipped in to buy our teacher a birthday present.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 gaap3 fan2 maai5 zo2 fan2 saang1 jat6 lai5 mat6 bei2 ngo5 dei6 go3 lou5 si1。
text: 我哋一齊夾份買咗份生日禮物俾我哋個老師。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You shouldn't say those kind of things in front of the children.

jyutping: nei5 m4 jing1 goi1 hai2 di1 sai3 lou6 min6 cin4 gong2 maai4 di1 gam3 ge2 je5。
text: 你唔應該喺啲細路面前講埋啲咁嘅嘢。

author: dngzz1

english.text: He is afraid of snakes.

jyutping: keoi5 geng1 se4。
text: 佢驚蛇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I wish I had a room of my own.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 jau5 zi6 gei2 jat1 gaan1 fong4 zau6 hou2 laa3。
text: 如果我有自己一間房就好喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I thought I could smoke.

jyutping: ngo5 ji5 wai4 ni1 dou6 bei2 sik6 jin1 ge3 tim1。
text: 我以為呢度俾食煙嘅添。

author: kaenif

english.text: What happened to you?

jyutping: nei5 me1 si6 aa1？
text: 你咩事呀？

author: GlossaMatik

english.text: No comment.

jyutping: bat1 zok3 ping4 leon6。
text: 不作評論。

author: kaenif

english.text: What difference does it make if people are looking at us?

jyutping: di1 jan4 mong6 zyu6 ngo5 dei6 jau6 dim2 ze1？
text: 啲人望住我哋又點啫？

author: kaenif

english.text: The man tried to install his own antenna.

jyutping: go3 jan4 soeng4 si3 zong1 zi6 gei2 tiu4 tin1 sin3。
text: 個人嘗試裝自己條天線。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She works at this company from Monday to Sunday.

jyutping: keoi5 jau4 sing1 kei4 jat1 dou3 sing1 kei4 jat6 dou1 hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou3 faan1 gung1。
text: 佢由星期一到星期日都喺呢間公司到返工。

author: nickyeow

english.text: My mother gets up early.

jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa1 hou2 zou2 hei2 san1。
text: 我阿媽好早起身。

author: nickyeow

english.text: After the bird had sung, it flew away.

jyutping: zek3 zoek3 zai2 coeng3 jyun4 go1 zau6 fei1 zau2 zo2。
text: 隻雀仔唱完歌就飛走咗。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We really miss Tom.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 aa3 Tom。
text: 我哋真係好掛住阿Tom。

author: nickyeow

english.text: A puppet doesn't know that it is being manipulated.

jyutping: ce2 sin3 gung1 zai2 m4 zi1 dou3 zi6 gei2 bei2 jan4 cou1 hung3。
text: 扯線公仔唔知道自己俾人操控。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Crap, I spent too much money.

jyutping: puk1 gaai1，sai2 do1 zo2 tim1。
text: 仆街，使多咗添。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Mama! That lady and man are holding hands, they're great friends aren't they!

jyutping: maa1 mi4！go2 go3 ze1 ze1 tung4 go2 go3 go1 go1 hai2 dou3 to1 sau2 sau2，keoi5 dei6 jat1 ding6 hai6 hou2 hou2 ge3 pang4 jau5 laa3！
text: 媽咪！嗰個姐姐同嗰個哥哥喺到拖手手，佢哋一定係好好嘅朋友喇！

author: nickyeow

english.text: Intelligent people are often arrogant.

jyutping: di1 lek1 ge3 jan4 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hou2 hiu1。
text: 啲叻嘅人通常都好囂。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He is a smart person. By which I mean, I agree with his opinions.

jyutping: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 cung1 ming4 ge3 jan4。ze1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 ji3 si1 hai6 ngo5 zaan3 sing4 keoi5 ge3 tai2 faat3。
text: 佢係一個好聰明嘅人。啫係我嘅意思係我贊成佢嘅睇法。

author: aizilan

english.text: Cheers!

jyutping: gon1 bui1！
text: 乾杯！

author: nickyeow

english.text: Be serious.

jyutping: jing6 zan1 di1 laa1。
text: 認真啲啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't forget to turn off the stove.

jyutping: gei3 zyu6 sik1 lou4 aa3。
text: 記住熄爐呀。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't want to make new friends!

jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 sik1 san1 pang4 jau5 aa3！
text: 我唔想識新朋友呀！

author: nickyeow

english.text: We don't know where Tom went.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 zi1 aa3 Tom heoi3 zo2 bin1。
text: 我哋唔知阿Tom去咗邊。

author: clowergen

english.text: How long had you been waiting when we arrived?

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 dou3 go2 zan6，nei5 ji5 ging1 dang2 zo2 gei2 noi6 aa2？
text: 我哋到嗰陣，你已經等咗幾耐啊？

english.text: The impression that science is over has occurred many times in various branches of human knowledge, often because of an explosion of discoveries made by a genius or a small group of men in such a short time that average minds could hardly follow and had the unconscious desire to take breath, to get used to the unexpected things that came to be revealed. Dazzled by these new truths, they could not see beyond.

jyutping: fo1 hok6 ji5 ging1 jyun4 git3 ge3 jan3 zoeng6 ji5 ging1 hai2 jan4 leoi6 zi1 sik1 ge3 m4 tung4 fan1 zi1 zung1 faat3 sang1 gwo3 hou2 do1 ci3，hou2 do1 si4 dou1 hai6 jan1 wai6 jat1 go3 tin1 coi4 waak6 ze2 jat1 baan1 jan4 hai2 gam3 dyun2 si4 gaan3 noi6 faat3 jin6 ge3 baau3 zaa3，jat1 bun1 jan4 ge3 tau4 nou5 hou2 naan4 gan1 ceoi4，jik6 dou1 jau5 mou4 ji3 sik1 ge3 juk6 mong6 jiu3 fu1 kap1，jiu3 zaap6 gwaan3 di1 ji3 soeng2 bat1 dou3 ge3 si6，jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 bei2 ni1 di1 san1 ge3 zan1 soeng3 so2 jyun6 muk6，tai2 m4 dou3 gang1 jyun5 ge3 dei6 fong1。
text: 科學已經完結嘅印象已經喺人類知識嘅唔同分支中發生過好多次，好多時都係因為一個天才或者一班人喺咁短時間內發現嘅爆炸，一般人嘅頭腦好難跟隨，亦都有無意識嘅慾望 要呼吸，要習慣啲意想不到嘅事，因為佢哋畀呢啲新嘅真相所眩目，睇唔到更遠嘅地方。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: While most of the tribes survived, not much is known so far about the welfare of one of the most secluded tribes, the Shompens, whose island took the brunt of the waves. A few members of the tribe have been sighted and even shot arrows at a military helicopter that hovered over their island on a post-tsunami reconnaissance trip.

jyutping: seoi1 jin4 daai6 bou6 fan6 bou6 lok6 dou1 hang6 cyun4 zo2，daan6 hai6 dou3 muk6 cin4 wai4 zi2，deoi3 jyu1 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 zeoi3 jan2 bai3 ge3 bou6 lok6，zik1 hai6 Shompens ge3 fuk1 lei6，ngo5 dei6 bing6 m4 do1 zi1 dou3，jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 dou2 zeoi6 hai2 hoi2 long6 jap6 min6 sau6 dou3 cung5 daam3。hai2 hoi2 siu6 hau6 ge3 zing1 caat3 leoi5 hang4 jap6 min6，jau5 gei2 go3 bou6 lok6 sing4 jyun4 bei2 jan4 gin3 dou2，sam6 zi3 hoeng3 zyu6 jat1 gaa3 hai2 keoi5 dei6 dou2 soeng6 min6 pui4 wui4 gan2 ge3 gwan1 jung6 zik6 sing1 gei1 se6 zin3。
text: 雖然大部分部落都幸存咗，但係到目前為止，對於其中一個最隱蔽嘅部落，即係 Shompens 嘅福利，我哋並唔多知道，因為佢哋嘅島嶼喺海浪入面受到重擔。喺海嘯後嘅偵察旅行入面，有幾個部落成員畀人見到，甚至向住一架喺佢哋島上面徘徊緊嘅軍用直升機射箭。
